citations.claim: NS still green with empty NS queue (N=0,S=0) and EW demand (W queue 1) just before gap-out
NS yellow begins after actuated gap-out (signal yellow on N/S)
All-red before EW after only 1s yellow, violating yellow_seconds=3

counterfactual.change: actuated true -> false (single field) keeps same steps/traffic; fixed-time does not gap-terminate green so NS stays green through 326 and yellow_duration passes

explanation: Actuated controller truncates NS yellow to 1s instead of required 3s. NS green is gap-terminated at step 324 when NS queue empties (0) while EW (W) has demand (queue 1), so NS yellow starts at 325. It then lasts only one second (325→326 all-red) instead of yellow_seconds=3. With actuated=false the green is not gap-terminated and stays green through step 326, so no short yellow occurs - proving actuation is causal. Extending steps to 329 preserves the same 1s yellow violation, so not an end-of-run artifact.
vision_note: Steps 323-324 show the NS direction green with EW red, step 325 shows NS yellow with EW still red, and step 326 already shows all four approaches red. The yellow phase is thus visible for only one second before the all-red clearance, truncating the required 3-second yellow.
